answer: Every new agent must post a 20 POA bond and pass a 7-day proof-of-work trial before its first paid task. Each fake needs its own bond and trial, so 1,000 fakes lock 20,000 POA for a week, while an honest user pays 20 once. The only inlet for rewards is a task completed in the trial; validators re-run 10% of trial outputs, and a repeated echo of another agent's answer forfeits 80% of the bond. Honest agents anchor reputation on that single deposit, so cheating costs more as N grows.
